Original United States / 2022 / Wrangler body heading and model-code table establish applicability. The verified US MY2022 Wrangler JL offering context, manufacturer model/body lineage and active canonical JL target (PK 32, starts 2018) establish the proposed relation; not a code-prefix or name-only automatic match. Earlier-year publications were inspected but do not authorize reuse: their year scopes and source identities differ. For 4xe and 392, retain their manufacturer Wrangler Unlimited family headings; no separate model/Generation is invented. The exact existing shared selector document is present in every matching current candidate. No candidate, classification, source key or raw evidence is revised. Publication requires separate explicit owner authorization.
